transcript: If you keep waking up in the middle of the night, you probably think it's just because of your age, or that you simply needed the bathroom. That's what most people tell themselves. But what if that's not the real reason? Because here's the truth. Millions of people over 50 wake up at night, and almost all of them assume it's normal, so they ignore it. They check the time, turn to the other side, and try to fall back asleep. But your body doesn't wake you up for no reason. During the day, you stay distracted. You push things down. You keep moving, even when something feels off. Stress you didn't release. Thoughts you didn't process. Emotions you didn't allow yourself to feel. And at night, when everything goes quiet, your body finally gets a chance to speak. So it wakes you up. Not to annoy you, but to release what you've been holding in. That restless feeling. That pressure in your chest. Those thoughts that suddenly appear in the dark. That's not random. That's communication. So next time it happens, don't grab your phone right away. Just pause. Take a breath and ask yourself, What have I been carrying today that I never gave myself time to feel? Because sometimes, the reason you wake up at night is the same reason you can't fully rest during the day. Follow me and comment night if this keeps happening to you.
